items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I heard Mutt talk about that once too.

ctx.x: That's shit our music. Yeah. Well that's one thing War II was good for. That's why we made a big hit right out here in California. Against the black and tan band.
I heard Mutt talk about that once too. I forget what he called it, soft sweet swing or something like that. I don't know how he expressed it.
We used to say, that's the other feet.
